horizon.friends.title: Soro ndị enyi gwuo egwu
horizon.friends.hint: Ndị enyi na-amanye koodu ahụ ka bọtịnụ ndị enyi gachara aha ihuenyo ahụ, na njikọ Direct, ma ọ bụ na ibe Play nke onye mbido.
horizon.friends.share_intro: Kekọrịta ụwa a n'azụ koodu ịkpọ òkù: ọ ga-emepe na LAN, ndị enyi na ịntanetị sonye na koodu ahụ. Ọ nweghị ihe nkesa nke anyị metụtara.
horizon.friends.short_code_changed: Mmadụ nọgidere na-agbalị koodu dị mkpirikpi na-ezighi ezi, ya mere ọ gbanwere.
horizon.friends.relay_stopped: Koodu mkpụmkpụ na-ezighi ezi karịrị oke, ya mere relay agbanyụrụ ruo mgbe i ga-ekerịta ọzọ. Ndị enyi ka nwere ike iso na koodu zuru oke.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Koodu ịkpọ oku gị adịla njikere: NchNhr Egwuregwu, Soro ndị enyi gwuo egwu. Detuo ya ma ziga ya ndị enyi gị.
